description: Set the most minutes of active cooking a dinner may take, every day or on the weekdays named. One single date is set_max_cooking_time_for_date; the time until dinner is on the table, oven included, is upsert_max_total_time_rule. A rule about the same thing is changed, not added twice. Soft unless the household says it must hold.

minutes.description: Maximum active minutes at the stove, 5-240.

strength.description: Soft unless the household says the rule must hold. Hard ONLY when the words are must/never/always (må/aldri/alltid/skal/kan ikke/ikke lov). Everything else is Soft — a preference the planner may bend on a tight week — including a bare statement said in passing («Taco på fredager», «Fisk to ganger i uka», «Maks 30 minutter på hverdager») and helst/gjerne/prøv. «Maks», «minst» and a number name the limit, not its strength: they do not make a rule Hard.

weekdays.description: The weekdays the maximum holds on; omit for every day.

name: upsert_max_cooking_time_rule
title: Limit time at the stove
